summary: Six bugs were found across four functions in the grades module, all rated High or Medium risk. Two off-by-one boundary errors (letterGrade at 90, passRate at 60) produced wrong letter grades and pass-rate percentages; classAverage returned NaN on empty input due to division by zero; topStudents silently mutated the caller's array; and medianPoints was broken for all inputs because it sorted numbers lexicographically, and additionally computed the wrong median for even-length arrays. All six issues were fixed, and 27 tests now guard against each regression.
recommendations: Add input-validation or TypeScript overloads to enforce non-empty arrays where NaN is not a valid return.
Enable a lint rule (e.g. eslint-plugin-unicorn's no-array-sort-mutation) to catch in-place sort side-effects.
Add boundary-value test cases (e.g. exactly-threshold scores) to the project's standard test suite.
Run the 27 generated tests in CI to prevent regressions on all fixed issues.
